name: Borrowed Ink
shortDescription: A stoppered bottle of oak-gall ink that is not yours.
examineDescription: A squat glass bottle of oak-gall ink, stoppered with cork and sealed over with candle wax so it cannot weep in a satchel. Quire's initial is scratched into the wax. There is enough here to ink a leaf properly, once, which is exactly why she wants it back and exactly why you are thinking about it.
